title: SDD Cycle State (sdd/specs/{spec-id}/cycles/cycle-XX/cycle.json)
description: State of one cycle. Created by sdd-orchestrator with status in-progress; only sdd-reviewer may set status completed (after the CONTEXTO GATE).

flow.description: full = complete cycle (brief.yaml + functional.md + planner.md + architect.md, one role each). reduced = structural refactor without user stories (may omit functional/planner/architect). lite = single-actor cycle: plan.md replaces the four documents (profile solo or [LITE] prefix). Absent = full.

plan.description: Path to plan.md (flow: lite only): objective, stories, tasks in prose and technical decisions in one document

documents.description: Paths of the cycle documents that exist. flow: reduced cycles may omit functional/planner/architect; flow: lite cycles list plan.md instead of them.

artifacts.description: Support docs under cycle-XX/artifacts/ (files or directories), not implemented source files. Paths are relative to the cycle directory (artifacts/x) or to the repo root.

tasks_skipped.description: Tasks closed as skipped (resolved / not applicable), not pending. Absent is read as 0. tasks_completed + tasks_skipped must equal tasks_total in a completed cycle.

usage.description: Consolidated telemetry for the whole cycle, written by the reviewer at close. Since v0.11.0 it is a SUM, not an estimate: by_agent lists every agent unit that consumed tokens (each recorded when its unit closed) and by_tier is derived from by_agent grouped by provider_model. Mandatory in the protocol; the field stays optional in the schema so cycles closed before v0.9.0 keep validating, but the validator errors on cycles completed from 2026-09-02 without provider/model + tokens, and warns when by_agent is missing or does not sum to by_tier. With no counter (Copilot, Antigravity) record a declared estimate with approx: true and source: declared-estimate — never omit.

approx.description: true when the numbers are a declared estimate rather than a counter reading. The viewer marks these as "estimado". Absent is read as false (measured).

by_tier.description: Derived from by_agent: tokens grouped by provider_model (claude/opus, gemini/pro, copilot/gpt-5-mini). Antigravity records under gemini/*. Bare legacy keys (haiku|sonnet|opus|fable) are still accepted and read as claude/*. sum(by_agent) must equal sum(by_tier) — the validator warns otherwise.

^(haiku|sonnet|opus|fable|(claude|gemini.description: Per-model tokens. approx/source override the parent usage values for this model, so a cycle mixing a measured provider with an estimated one stays honest.

tokens_total.description: Exact total when the source reports a single number (agent-usage-notification). tokens_in/tokens_out then carry the documented default split (85/15) so the cost formula still works; the viewer shows tokens_total.

by_agent.description: One entry per agent unit of work (a task, the functional/planner/architect documents, the review itself, coordination). Whoever executes records; the reviewer only appends its own entry and sums. Source of truth for by_tier.

usageSource.description: Where the number came from. session-report: the harness session usage report (Claude Code main loop). stats-command: /stats (Gemini CLI). api-usage: usage returned by the model API. agent-usage-notification: the exact per-subagent count the harness reports to the parent when a subagent finishes (Claude Code Agent tool: <usage><subagent_tokens>N</subagent_tokens>…</usage>) — exact, approx: false. declared-estimate: the agent declared an order-of-magnitude estimate because the harness exposes no counter (Copilot, Antigravity, Gemini CLI subagents) — MUST pair with approx: true.

agentUsage.description: Consumption of ONE agent's unit of work, written by that agent when it closes the unit (or by the orchestrator/reviewer when it receives the harness usage notification for a subagent). Mandatory since v0.11.0 for every unit that consumed tokens.

agent.description: SDD role that did the work. custom = any other agent; name it in label.

label.description: Free label when agent is custom, or to tell two runs of the same role apart (e.g. TASK-003).

provider_model.description: Provider-namespaced model actually used: claude/sonnet, gemini/pro, copilot/claude-sonnet. Antigravity records under gemini/*.

effort.description: Effort / thinking level declared BEFORE executing (Claude: low|medium|high|xhigh|max; Gemini: minimal|low|medium|high; none when the harness exposes no control).

tokens_total.description: Exact total when the source reports a single number (agent-usage-notification). tokens_in/tokens_out then carry the documented default split (85/15) so the cost formula still works; the viewer shows tokens_total.

approx.description: true when tokens are a declared estimate rather than a counter reading.

recorded_at.description: When the unit closed (date or ISO datetime).

tool_uses.description: tool_uses from the usage notification, when available.
